summary: Flight-recorder dossier specimen: three-pane ruled workbench with cite-back signature, summary-first docked tool trace (Read/Write/Edit/Bash/WebSearch), in-place running/failed/empty states, affidavit tri-voice type, and 375px stacking rule.

claims.claim: Three-pane dossier resolves hierarchy: calm center reading column flanked by ruled resumption and evidence wings
Cite-back line on every verification view and expanded tool footer certifies evidence without detaching it from its claim
Summary-first docked tool rows with in-place expand, skeleton, failure-retry and empty states cover happy and non-happy paths
Affidavit tri-voice type and rationed signal color keep status legible without color-only encoding

decisions.choice: Dock tool-trace rows directly beneath the claiming assistant turn as ruled rows; one expanded Edit shows command, excerpt and diff with cite-back footer
rationale: Keeps evidence attached to the claim that produced it
Lets 50-plus turns compress to summary lines without losing cite-back scannability
alternatives: Card pile with shadows per turn
risks: Dense turns grow tall before collapse
revisitWhen: Builder proves a detached timeline verifies faster in usability testing

decisions.choice: Paper ledger with hairline rules; status as pip plus icon plus uppercase label; failures and skeletons resolve in place with retry
rationale: Record never breaks its own continuity
Meaning survives grayscale and reduced motion
risks: Quiet ground may under-signal failure urgency
revisitWhen: Contrast audit against WCAG AA fails on paper ground

risks: Quiet paper ground may read archival unless status crispness carries energy
Dense wings may leak noise into the reading path if rule weights slip
Long stub runs may feel frozen without staged skeleton-to-row resolution
